how.title: How it works
how.lede: Your report is processed in four steps. You can review extracted values before reading explanations.
how.desc1: Choose a PDF or a clear PNG/JPEG photo of the report.
how.desc2: Optical character recognition reads printed text from each page.
how.desc3: Review test names, values, units, and the ranges printed by the lab. Correct unclear values.
how.desc4: See a plain-language explanation and the exact OCR line it came from.

privacy.title: Privacy and Help
privacy.lede: Clear information about report handling and common questions.
privacy.storage: The uploaded file, OCR text, and extracted values are stored in this server's SQLite database so you can reopen the report from History, including after a page reload.
privacy.duration: Guest reports are automatically deleted after 24 hours by default, or you can delete one sooner. The server administrator can change the retention period.
privacy.access: The application does not send reports to an AI or third-party processing service. Reports are available only in the browser that uploaded them, but anyone with access to the server or database files may be able to read them.
privacy.deleteTitle: How do I delete a report?
privacy.delete: Use Delete report on the report summary. This removes its uploaded file and saved report data from this app's database.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.files.a: One PDF, PNG, or JPEG file up to 12 MB. Clear, upright images and text-based PDFs usually work best.
faq.unclear.q: What if a value is unclear?
faq.unclear.a: It is marked Needs review. Check the original report, enter the correct number, and save it before opening the explanation.
faq.language.a: Use the English / اردو controls in the header. Your choice is saved in this browser. Explanations can be shown in English, Urdu, or both.
faq.review.q: Why does a value say “Needs review”?
faq.review.a: The OCR could not confidently read a numeric value or reference range. The app does not explain that result until you correct and save the value.
faq.doctor.a: No. This tool offers a simple explanation of text and ranges from your report. It does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
faq.support.a: This standalone installation has no support mailbox configured. Contact the person or organization that set up this server.
faq.password.q: How can I reset my password?
faq.password.a: Password reset email is not configured in this standalone app. Contact the server administrator. Guest use does not require an account.
